items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: in 33 when Bill was brought back, all the little Bill Paul was throwing three and four pieces every Friday and Saturday

ctx.x: I was going to get out of the mobile on Mondays, I think we'd make it six or eight dollars, something like that. Rich. Random money. Don't be telling me.
Yeah. That's right. And I mean, see, in 33 when Bill was brought back, all the little Bill Paul was throwing three and four pieces every Friday and Saturday. Oh yeah, everything would jump up.
